pose: upward view from a quiet courtyard

visible_description: 薄荷白塔的几层露台托起悬空花园，柔绿植被与深玻璃缝呈现清爽未来生活空间。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a mint-white residential tower with suspended garden terraces. Use three broad offset terraces, each with low planting and one small tree, keeping the tower crown below the upper fifth. A narrow warm entrance light anchors the base. Render the smooth facade and glass recesses with restrained detail. No people, traffic, signs, or repeated skyline blocks clutter the composition. Use painterly futuristic city vignette. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
